MODIFICATIONS
-------------

These files are served from magesticanstudios.com rather than from Google's
CDN, so that opening a page on this site does not send a request to a third
party or execute code fetched from one at page load. Three changes were made to
the bytes Google published at

    https://www.gstatic.com/firebasejs/10.12.2/

and no others:

  1. The absolute import of firebase-app.js that each of the other bundles
     carries was rewritten from the gstatic URL to the relative "./"
     specifier, so the bundles resolve each other locally.
  2. CRLF line endings were normalised to LF.
  3. Comments were removed, as they are from every other JavaScript file this
     site serves.

The transform is a script, not a hand edit, and it is reproducible: the SHA-256
of the upstream bytes and of the file as it sits here are both recorded, so
anyone can fetch the original and confirm what changed.

Files: firebase-app.js, firebase-app-check.js, firebase-firestore-lite.js,
firebase-auth.js.
